measured_problem: At fixed 300-record-per-capability coverage, the existing decoder passes the locked layer-zero gates with exact native attention (cosine 0.996189, relative RMSE 0.051032). The deployed v15 compact attention remains the only non-realizable interface in that pass.
proposed_method: Initialize immutable v15 layer 0, refit only its existing primary and secondary compact-attention parameters for exactly one deterministic pass over 4200 training records against native source attention, then analytically extract the already proven rank-768 linear-plus-three-route decoder on those fitted attention states. Persist a layer-only checkpoint only on a held-out pass.
material_differences: Changes no LayerCake architecture, parameters, artifact size, active paths, or inference operations.
Uses the single fixed coverage budget proven sufficient by V377 and preserves all 28 validation identities.
Separates attention optimization from the closed-form decoder instead of jointly fitting unrelated layer parameters.
Uses exactly one deterministic training epoch and prohibits optimizer, epoch, data, or architecture sweeps.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered layer-zero extraction. A pass authorizes progressive multi-layer extraction under a separate protocol; any miss closes existing-architecture attention refitting without parameter, width, epoch, optimizer, data, context, decoder, route, rank, ridge, layer, source, or gate sweeps.
claim_boundary: Architecture-review authorization only; no trained attention, checkpoint, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority evidence.
